import unittest

from solution import aggregate_label


class AggregateLabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sums_exact_trimmed_label_matches(self):
        records = " apple ,fruit,10\nbanana, fruit , 7\napple,other,5\nApple,fruit,100"
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label(records, "apple"), 15)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label(records, "Apple"), 100)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label(records, "banana"), 7)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label(records, "missing"), 0)

    def test_empty_records_and_quantity_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label("", "x"), 0)
        records = "x,a,0\nx,b,1000000\ny,c,1"
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label(records, "x"), 1000000)

    def test_supplied_label_is_not_trimmed(self):
        records = " x ,category,4"
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label(records, "x"), 4)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_label(records, " x "), 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            aggregate_label(records, "")
        for label in (None, 1, True):
            with self.subTest(label=label):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    aggregate_label(records, label)

    def test_records_must_be_string(self):
        for records in (None, [], 3, b"x,c,1"):
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    aggregate_label(records, "x")

    def test_blank_lines_are_invalid(self):
        for records in ("\n", "x,c,1\n\n", "x,c,1\n   \ny,c,2", "   "):
            with self.subTest(records=repr(records)):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    aggregate_label(records, "x")

    def test_each_line_requires_exactly_three_nonempty_named_fields(self):
        malformed = (
            "x,c", "x,c,1,extra", ",c,1", "x,,1",
            "x,c,1\ny,d", "x,c,1\ny,,2",
        )
        for records in malformed:
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    aggregate_label(records, "x")

    def test_quantity_requires_ascii_decimal_integer_in_range(self):
        invalid_quantities = (
            "-1", "+1", "1.0", "1_000", " 1 0 ",
            "1000001", "１２", "١", "", "abc",
        )
        for quantity in invalid_quantities:
            with self.subTest(quantity=quantity):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    aggregate_label("x,c," + quantity, "x")

    def test_strings_are_unchanged(self):
        records = "x, c, 2\ny,d,3"
        label = "x"
        aggregate_label(records, label)
        self.assertEqual(records, "x, c, 2\ny,d,3")
        self.assertEqual(label, "x")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
